doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Rolf Kuhn's record and the Finnish Hunters and Gatherers
summary: Quick comments on clarinetist Rolf Kuhn's date and on a Finnish record with Jukkis Uotila, Jarmo Savolainen and bassist Anders Jormin.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: . . . and put it down on paper and fleshed it out. Here’s an interesting record with Rolf Kuhn, Chuck Loeb, Dieter Ilg, and Wolfgang Haffner.
Yeah. A great clarinet player that . . .
Very good, very talented guy. Of course I knew . . .
. . . Joachim very well. But he’s an opera conductor. He’s pretty set up there.
Yeah, but a really heavyweight clarinet player. Here’s another date with Jukkis, with Jarmo – this is for Jamey’s label.
That’s Jarmo, and on this, Jormin?
He was a killer bass player. That’s a very good record. Headhunters? Gatherers?
I have that. Hunters and Gatherers. I have – Jukkis gave it to me.
Hunters and Gatherers. That’s a nice record, good sound, very good tunes, and Ander Jormin, man, is wooo, a very heavy bass player.
